scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tokens -w packages/prose -w packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w packages/tokens -w packages/prose -w packages/ui -w apps/storybook
scripts.check:publint: publint run packages/tokens --strict && publint run packages/prose --strict && publint run packages/ui --strict
scripts.storybook: npm run build && npm run dev -w apps/storybook
scripts.storybook:build: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/storybook
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run check:css && npm test && npm run check:publint && npm run check:pack
